subtitle: A workout log app that spots your personal bests.
about: A small app inside a Pinto Notes note, with your plan, every session and the bests worked out from them. Tell your AI what you did to log it, or log and plan sessions yourself.

ask.prompt: Set up the workout log template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: Log a session
slides.ai: Logged it. That's your fastest 5 km yet, 1:30 faster than the last one.
slides.alt: Sessions: Saturday's easy run, 5 km in 28:40, marked New best

slides.label: Ask how it's going
slides.you: Am I getting stronger on squats?
slides.ai: Yes. Your squat went from 90 kg to 100 kg for 5 since 18 October, a new best each Legs day.
slides.alt: Progress for the squat: estimated one-rep max up 12 kg since 18 October, and the personal bests

slides.label: Use it yourself
slides.note: Or log and plan it yourself.
slides.alt: Today: 3 of 3 sessions this week, and Legs next with last time's sets
